name: DeKalb Summer Youth Employment Program (DSYEP)
org: DeKalb County Government and WorkSource DeKalb
what_you_do: These are paid summer internships with county partners. Fields include healthcare, education, technology, retail and government. In 2025, 350 interns worked Monday to Thursday. They worked up to 24 hours a week.
who_can_apply: 2025 rules: DeKalb County residents ages 16 to 21 who pass a drug screening and background check. Interns were picked by random lottery.
deadline_text: In 2025 registration ran Apr 10 to Apr 20 (11:59 p.m.). No 2026 or 2027 cycle was found on the county site.
how_to_apply: In 2025, online registration at dekalbcountyga.gov/dsyep. That address now leads to a registration form marked no longer active. For help the 2025 county release listed the Workforce Development Manager at (470) 572-8229.
notes: Confirm that a new cycle exists before planning around it. All dates, pay and rules here are from the 2025 county release. WorkSource DeKalb also lists youth ages 16 to 24 with barriers as a service group. It sends people to ATLworks.org to check eligibility. Georgia requires a work permit only under 16, and this program starts at 16.
